criteria.requirement: Fix CodeGenerator.visit_Include synchronous without-context handling so buffered macro/set/filter frames append real included events via simple_write, instead of making the macro return a generator representation. Preserve top-level streaming, actual without-context isolation, nested macros, ignore missing, autoescape and existing async parity. Do not silently switch to with context or reevaluate include arguments; demonstrate concrete rendered output through actual compilation/render/generate paths.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
